Query.Name: 売掛残高一覧
Query.SQL: SELECT customer_code , MIN(customer_name) AS customer_name , SUM(amount) AS amount FROM sales GROUP BY customer_code ;

Query.Name: 得意先別売上順位
Query.SQL: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(price) DESC) AS Rank , customer_code , MIN(customer_name) , SUM(price) FROM sales WHERE CONVERT(DATE, sale_date) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_code ORDER BY SUM(price) DESC ;

Query.Name: 担当者別売上順位
Query.SQL: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(price) DESC) AS Rank , customers.primary_staff_code , MIN(staffs.name) , SUM(price) FROM sales LEFT JOIN customers ON sales.customer_code = customers.code LEFT JOIN staffs ON customers.primary_staff_code = staffs.code WHERE CONVERT(DATE, sale_date) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customers.primary_staff_code ORDER BY SUM(price) DESC ;
